info.title: Merchant Commerce Adapter
info.description: Complete machine-readable platform-neutral merchant-authoritative commerce contract, merchant-commerce-adapter/v1. All operation request and response schemas are defined in the adjacent commerce-adapter-schemas.json file.

servers.description: Relative deployment base path; the merchant/provider deployment supplies the origin.

get.description: Discovery is authenticated and returns a versioned capability document with an explicit expiry. It has no HTTP idempotency key. Required capability: `capability.discovery`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.description: Required capability: `catalog.search`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

get.description: Required capability: `catalog.product`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.description: Required capability: `catalog.availability`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

Quote creation is a read-like resolution unless the capability declares a reservation; in that case the adapter applies mutation idempotency. Required capability: `commerce.quote`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

get.description: Required capability: `customer.lookup`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `loyalty.lookup`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.description: Required capability: `cart.create`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

get.description: Required capability: `cart.read`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

patch.description: Required capability: `cart.update`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.summary: Validate merchant cart and resolve deltas
post.description: Required capability: `cart.validate`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.summary: Reconcile conversational proposal into merchant cart
post.description: Required capability: `cart.reconcile`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `cart.expire`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `checkout.create`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated. The `checkout.redirect` capability is declared separately when hosted-checkout fallback is available.

get.description: Required capability: `checkout.read`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.description: Required capability: `checkout.cancel`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `payment.authorize`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `payment.capture`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `order.create`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.
Required capability: `order.confirm`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

get.description: Required capability: `order.read`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.description: Required capability: `order.cancel`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

get.description: Required capability: `fulfillment.status`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

get.summary: Reconcile an accepted or unknown operation
get.description: Required capability: `operation.status`. Merchant scope and correlation are server-authenticated.

post.description: Webhook processing does not use Idempotency-Key. The receiver authenticates the request and deduplicates valid events by the CloudEvents identity tuple `(source, id)` before applying effects. Required capability: `events.webhook`.

200.description: Accepted or safely acknowledged duplicate event

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: OAuth 2.0 access token; audience/resource and merchant scope are deployment-bound.

MerchantId.name: X-Merchant-Id
MerchantId.description: Authenticated merchant scope; a body value cannot widen it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for state-changing HTTP operations. It identifies one mutation and is not used for webhook event deduplication.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Required when the capability advertises optimistic concurrency.

IdempotencyKeyOptional.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyOptional.description: Optional for quote resolution; required when the declared quote capability creates a reservation or other state change. It is not used for webhook event deduplication.

CorrelationId.description: Correlation ID echoed by the adapter.

x-canonical-operation-aliases.httpMutationIdempotency: Idempotency-Key is required for state-changing HTTP operations; it is distinct from webhook event deduplication by (source, id).

x-capability-vocabulary: Every canonical operation has an x-capability annotation; checkout.redirect is an adjunct capability required for redirect fallback, not a separate operation.
